title: watchdogBanSystem
description: A mc moderation plugin. Simple lightweight for paper and best for low to high networks.
body:
playerayer'sayer's️ WatchdogBanSystem
The ultimate lightweight moderation suite for modern Minecraft servers.
WatchdogBanSystem is a high-performance, easy-to-use moderation plugin specifically optimized for Paper servers. Designed for administrators who want total control without the lag of heavy, bloated alternatives, Watchdog ensures your community stays safe and clean.

✨ Key Features
🚀 Ultra Lightweight: Optimized code to ensure zero impact on your server's TPS.
🔨 Advanced Punishment System: Easily manage bans, mutes, and kicks with simple commands.
📄 Detailed Logging: Keep track of every staff action to maintain accountability.
⚡ Paper Optimized: Built from the ground up to take advantage of Paper’s performance enhancements.
⚙️ Fully Configurable: Customize messages, durations, and permissions to fit your server's style.

🛠️ Commands & Permissions
Command	Description	Permission
/tempban <player> [reason]	temporary ban a player	    |watchdog.tempban
/unban <player>	Remove a player's ban	                |watchdog.unban
/mute <player> [reason]	Prevent a player from chatting	|watchdog.mute
/kick <player> [reason]	Remove a player from the server	|watchdog.kick
/watchdog reload	Reload the configuration file	    |watchdog.admin

📥 Installation
Download the latest .jar file.
Drop it into your server's plugins folder.
Restart your server.
Configure the config.yml to your liking!
Support for this plugin is available via the "Issues" tab. If you find a bug, please report it there!
